reason: I can't catch my breath and my chest hurts when I breathe.
diagnosis: Most likely pulmonary embolism causing sudden pleuritic chest pain and exertional dyspnea, with no fever, cough, or leg swelling and an acute onset over one day.
keyPoints: Onset and progression of shortness of breath and chest pain
Pleuritic nature of pain, location, and radiation to back
PE red flags: cough, hemoptysis, unilateral leg swelling, immobility, recent surgery/travel, prior clots
Cardiac/respiratory symptoms: orthopnea, wheeze, fever, syncope, exertional limitation
Smoking history and risk of COPD/asthma
Past medical history and medications, especially hypertension and any anticoagulant use
Family history and any provoking factors or trauma
manner: anxious, worried about cancer, answers clearly
